verdict.rationale: Raygun's crash reporting page says you can order and prioritize errors by users affected as well as occurrence count. That covers the core of ranking by blast radius rather than raw event volume. Smart filters by version, OS, browser, location and tags let you segment that impact further. Missing for 10: per-issue counts of affected sessions, detailed docs on how affected users are counted and shown on each issue, and independent or hands-on corroboration (the support rests on a single marketing claim).
